tracks.title: Tấm Vé Bằng Sáp Màu
tracks.subject: Chú Lực, a strict ticket inspector on Hà Nội's Cát Linh metro, finds a six-year-old boy riding every morning with a ticket drawn in crayon; he stamps it as valid day after day, until the station chief comes down to inspect and Chú Lực has to defend a drawing.
